_doc: Overrides of the stone_rock, concrete_plaster and brick worker (layout as ../overrides.json).
b3f387 roof tiles, 67faf4 red brick (dark joints), d8313a carved brick, 141db2 snowy brick (dark outlined joints; its
snow then sits on top): the art's darker parts are the low side (b +1). 67faf4 and b3f387: their joints are barely
darker than the clay, so a stronger relief (a) to read as recessed; 3dcc78 (high-contrast mortar): a gentler one.
829dd2 obsidian (8x8, black): polished (a -1: no art relief, pits or grain, a glassy sheen), broad (scale 2).
06c252, 6e6c42, 88bcdd carved or engraved plaster: more of the art's relief. bd3674 and 54bb9c marble: smoother and
glossier, finer, no grime. 8dd2e5 lava crust: no cracks or grime (the art has its own glowing cracks). The b rows of
stone: hairline cracks where the art shows cut or weathered rock.
